title: Copy a whole folder from a remote computer
summary: Use scp with the recursive flag to copy an entire directory and all its contents from a remote computer to your local machine. This is handy for backing up project folders or downloading large datasets.
prerequisites: SSH access to the remote host

steps.explain: Recursively copy the contents of a directory from the remote host to a local directory.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: Hostname or IP of the remote computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory on the remote computer
